Messages.Body:
I've updated the template used by ARDB to generate JOL-compatible deck files.
Previously, there was 1 line per card copy.
Now copies are regrouped and sorted+grouped by type.

JOL stylesheet for ARDB (Right-click > Save as)

To be copied in the xsl subfolder of ARDB.
